headline: Southern New Hampshire lead with their conference schedule complete
dek: Southern New Hampshire have played all nine of their conference matches and stand on twenty points, three clear of American International. Two matches between members remain: Franklin Pierce against Assumption, and American International at home to Adelphi.
displaced_by: The standing dek named one match left between members; today's list carries two, with American International against Adelphi as well, so the lead can no longer be called secure on the data alone

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-two goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have scored fifty-two goals and conceded ten this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored fifteen of Franklin Pierce's twenty-nine goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost ten matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won eight matches and lost seven, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept seven clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: Pace have lost every match they have played since beating American International.

next_match.line: Adelphi are the only side to have beaten Southern New Hampshire this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
